tandemFrageBeispiel.frage: What will you do if it rains?
tandemFrageBeispiel.antwort: We'll stay in if it rains.

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Will you call me tonight?”

B hears the question and builds the answer. Choose from the tile when / if: when for something that will surely happen, if for something that might not happen. Put an -s on the blue verb if you need to.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: When – it will certainly happen. If – it might not happen.

tandemRedemittel.p1: Sorry? Can you say that again, please?

tandemFragen.antwort: I'll call you when the baby goes to sleep.

tandemFragen.frage: What if the train is cancelled?
tandemFragen.antwort: We'll get a taxi if it's cancelled.

tandemFragen.frage: Tom might work late. Will he come?
tandemFragen.antwort: He'll come if he finishes early.

tandemFragen.frage: What will you do when your course ends?
tandemFragen.antwort: I'll look for a job when it ends.

tandemFragen.frage: What if you don't get the job?
tandemFragen.antwort: I'll apply again if that happens.

tandemFragen.frage: When will you visit your sister's new baby?
tandemFragen.antwort: We'll visit them when it's born.

tandemFragen.frage: Do you think you'll move abroad?
tandemFragen.antwort: I'll move to Spain if I find a job.

tandemFragen.frage: Why are you packing an umbrella? It's sunny.
tandemFragen.antwort: I'll need it if it rains.
It will open when the owner arrives.

tandemFragen.frage: Will the match go ahead? It might rain.
tandemFragen.antwort: It will go ahead if the rain stops.
